### open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib)

### [`v0.161.0`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v01610)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/compare/v0.160.0...v0.161.0)

##### 🛑 Breaking changes 🛑

- `all`: Remove the deprecated mezmo exporter. ([#​49953](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/49953))
  Use the OTLP/HTTP exporter to send logs directly to Mezmo instead. See
  <https://docs.mezmo.com/telemetry-pipelines/otel-collector> and
  <https://docs.mezmo.com/telemetry-pipelines/open-telemetry-source> for migration guidance.

##### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `otelcol-contrib`: Upgrade go.opentelemetry.io/obi to v0.13.0 ([#​1643](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1643))
